$about: Sky & atmosphere defaults. Every key is optional — anything left out falls back to the schema default in config.ts, and anything invalid falls back with a console warning rather than breaking the sky. Colours are sRGB hex. Angles are degrees. Distances are metres.

projection.$about: mode infinite is the backdrop at infinity — no parallax, the horizon follows the camera. mode dome stands a finite ellipsoid over the map instead: radius is its horizontal half-width in metres, heightScale its vertical radius as a fraction of that (below 1 flattens the dome and bunches the gradient toward the horizon), yOffset the height of its horizon line. It has to clear the map and should sit inside the camera's far plane.

sky.$about: The four gradient stops run bottom to top: lowerHorizon (below the horizon line), horizon, upperSky, zenith. dayNightBlend decides how much the clock is allowed to override them — set it to 0 for a look that must stay as authored.

sun.$about: azimuth and elevation are overwritten every frame while time.driveCelestials is on; turn it off to place the sun by hand. size and glowRadius are angular radii in degrees — the real sun is about 0.27.

moon.$about: phase 0 is new, 0.5 is full, 1 is new again. Position is independent of phase.

stars.$about: density is cells per cube face, coverage the fraction of cells holding a star. Stars fade themselves out as the sun rises, so leaving this enabled in a daytime preset costs nothing visually.

clouds.$about: type picks a set of shaping multipliers over everything below — wispy, scattered, puffy, overcast, storm, volcanic. layerCount is capped by the quality mode. height is metres above the camera.

weather.$about: type is clear | rain | snow | storm | dust | ash. storm draws rain and additionally darkens the sky and enables lightning. visibility 1 is clear, 0.02 is a whiteout; it tightens the fog and washes the sky out.

lightning.$about: frequency is average strikes per minute. bolts draws a stylised bolt as well as the flash; the flash alone is nearly free.

atmosphere.$about: fogFollowsSky drives the fog colour from the live horizon colour, which is what stops a hard band appearing where the ground meets the sky. fogType exp2 ignores near/far and uses fogDensity.

lighting.$about: All synchronisation is opt-in and reversible: the system snapshots whatever it is handed and puts it back when a toggle goes false or on dispose. It never creates or replaces a light. driveFromSun derives colour and intensity from sun elevation; turn it off to use the values below literally.

time.$about: One clock for the whole system. Sunrise is 6:00 and sunset 18:00. cycleDuration is real seconds for a full 24 hours.

transition.$about: Defaults used by transitionToPreset when it is not given its own.
